description: Multiplying matrices and testing for the identity matrix (the same example on the Nano).
basis: the output of the example on the Uno (recorded on a real Uno R3, class hardware) holds for the Nano: it has the ATmega328P of the Uno at 16 MHz, the pins 0 to 19 are numbered alike (A0 = 14, pins_arduino.h of the eightanaloginputs variant) and the sketch uses neither A6 nor A7; no recording on a Nano exists
